Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to force push over a protected branch

What happens

Force push to the main branch. The call below tries to force push over a protected branch. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Git.

The call

git push --force origin main

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Protect main on the server (a GitHub branch protection rule or ruleset), leave force pushes off, and require a pull request. Administrators and bypass actors can skip these rules unless you enforce them for administrators, so the agent's token must not belong to either.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule git-force-push-protected-branch, first stopped in version 0.32.8.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
